B1.name: Compression Water Discharge
B1.description: Atlas enforces his authority by bending the water around him, dealing [Water] damage.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Water compresses into droplets and are hurled towards opponents, dealing % of defense as damage.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: A spiral of water that pinpoints on nearby opponents and strangles them, dealing % of defense as damage and inflicting the [Slowness] effect.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Slams an orb of water on the ground in front, dealing % of defense as small AoE damage and inflicting [Dazed].

additional.text: {{effect:slowness}}
{{effect:dazed}}

S1.name: Reflection Counter
S1.description: Atlas counters incoming attacks by raising a compressed water wall, dealing the damage that an incoming attack would deal back at the opponents as [Water] damage. This wall will remain even when Atlas is off-field and stays for seconds. AoE attacks will not be completely deflected.

additional.text: The repelled attack can crit, in fact, the crit chance and damage increases by +% for every 100 MP depleted from max MP overall (not just from this skill).
Whoever the shield is not repelling an attack, every second, a refund of MP will be given to Atlas equal to .
Cooldown: 15 seconds
Mana Cost: 200 MP

S2.name: Counterstrike(+)
S2.description: Throw quick, rapid magically imbued fist and compressed water projectile strikes, dealing % of defense as [Water] damage per strike, up to 15 strikes when this skill button is held down.

additional.text: When this skill ends, Atlas’ Basic Skill is greatly enhanced by an aura of blue mana, increasing his attack speed by +50% and initial damage increase of +%, consuming 15 MP per second and increasing damage increase by +% per second also. The enhancement ends when no MP remains or when another Special Skill is used (not including this Special Skill).
Cooldown: 14 seconds
Mana Cost: 80 MP

U1.name: Sage Cloud Surfer
U1.description: Atlas forms a transfiguration circle called Elevator of Heaven and summons a floating sage circle where he stands superior to his opponents until his mana is completely drained or when this skill button is pressed again.

additional.text: Whilst standing high, he gains +75% dodge chance and 100% increased movement speed. He loses -3% of max MP per second.
All attacks from skills he uses become ranged attacks that ignore 40% of the opponent’s defense.
When this mode ends, either through mana depletion or Ultimate Skill press, Atlas slams down onto the ground, sending a wave in all directions, dealing % of defense as [Water] AoE damage.
If MP is less than 10% when this skill activates, instead, restore % of max MP back and gain the effect [Magic Amplification].
{{effect:magic-amplification}}
Energy Gauge: 100%

T1.name: Tempest Aquia
T1.description: Ability: Plants a banner on the ground equal to 200% of defense which boosts all Tempest Aquia cohort members until it is destroyed.

additional.text: > +15% damage increase for each same cohort member in the party (max 3 stacks).
> Gain the [Resistance] effect.
> Accumulate [Shield] effect equal to 0.3% of Atlas’ defense every second.
When this skill is used again, if the banner still remains, sacrifice it to gain +150 MP per second for Atlas for 10 seconds. This activation ability does not cost energy.
{{effect:resistance}}
{{effect:shield}}
Resonance: No additional effects.

Dupes.description: Every time a Special Skill is used, recover 150 stamina points, and every time the Dash Skill is used, instantly recovers 50 MP.

additional.text: Atlas gains +3% piercing for each percentage of damage increase from his skills or any buffs (any mentioned elemental damage increase does not apply towards the count).
Incoming attacks are converted into [Shield] equivalent to 25% of defense plus 10% of the incoming attack's damage value before the attack’s damage takes effect.

When Atlas dashes, his interruption resistance is increased and he will deal 40% of his defense as damage to nearby opponents as short range [Water] projectile needles that automatically hones in on them. Summons 3 at a time.
{{effect:shield}}
The Basic Skill permanently becomes +20% faster. Adds a fourth stage to the Basic Skill of the following:

Stage 4: Form a vortex of water to swish opponents vigorously, dealing 130% of defense as AoE [Water] damage and restoring 40 MP per opponent hit. Increase damage by an additional +40% for opponents inflicted with a debuff. The damage increases by +10% for each level of the equipped Basic Skill, not counted as damage increase.
Increases the damage of Special Skills by +15%. This is considered a damage increase and will count for the piercing bonus.

When Atlas’ MP reaches below 15 points, automatically activate Special Skill: Reflection Counter even if it is not equipped. The skill will mimic the same level as the level of the owned skill itself.
When dashing, restore +30 more MP and summon an additional 6 water projectile needles. The needles become denser and will penetrate through multiple opponents before shattering.

Using two Special Skills in a brief moment will instantly charge the energy gauge by +20% and consume 130 MP. Also, the first Special Skill turns into Ultimate Skill: Black Hole Water Detonation which can be activated at any time if sufficient energy gauge is present.

Ultimate Skill: Black Hole Water Detonation - Atlas creates a vortex of compressed energy that sucks mana particles and then collapses in a wide AoE, dealing 450% of defense as [Water] damage and makes own buffs and debuffs applied stay for twice as long as its current duration remaining. Requires having 35% of energy gauge to activate. The skill’s damage increases by +10% per level of equipped Ultimate Skill, not counted as normal damage increase.
